# Isaiah Chapter 32 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 20 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Righteous king; fools exposed; complacent women warned; Spirit poured out; wilderness becomes garden*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**A King in Righteousness:** Righteous king; fools exposed; complacent women warned; Spirit poured out; wilderness becomes garden. The key message for modern readers: "The fruit of righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever"

*-- PNEUMA*
